axial.physical_domain: Positive affine axial factor of existing bead; contact and photo restrict joint values, no measured exact min/max.

count.physical_domain: Maker minimum2000; prior R306 box1800..3200 is historical, not adopted.

elevation.physical_domain: 0<elevation<=90deg for a camera above the plane; grazing deprojection is singular. No calibrated photograph-derived interval.

gap_steps.physical_domain: Open-end construction, nonnegative; finite prior interval is a search control.

light_el.physical_domain: Physical source direction above plane (0..90deg); historic fit box25..88.

light_inverse.physical_domain: Nonnegative inverse shared light distance; finite-source visibility remains required.

local_metric.physical_domain: Inherited R297 compact station-correction blend; inactive/zero in modern families. No independently measured physical interval.

local_phase_bias.physical_domain: Inherited R297 compact phase bias, radians; inactive/zero in modern families.

local_turn.physical_domain: Inherited R297 compact phase-rate blend; inactive/zero in modern families.

minor.physical_domain: Positive centerline radial offset; contact and camera bounds restrict each joint configuration. No measured independent min/max.

minor_y.physical_domain: Existing fractional image-height radius law; positive radius everywhere and contacts, not a measured ±4% law.

perspective.physical_domain: Nonnegative inverse camera distance, plus explicit nonsingular projection and camera-clearance bounds.

phase_transport.physical_domain: Inherited R297 compact correction transport blend; inactive/zero in modern families.

pitch.physical_domain: Modern mean advance is set by fixed count and true total arclength; saved pitch is unused. Original R297 compact local-metric law still uses its frozen pitch multiplier.

radius.physical_domain: Positive radius fixes the world-unit gauge; frozen at1.784536980648071 in these hypotheses.

roll.physical_domain: Periodic 360deg camera rotation; symmetries do not certify physical indexing.

roughness.physical_domain: Positive historical optical lobe parameter; no independent calibrated physical interval.

s0.physical_domain: Registration along one whole physical circuit, modulo length with coupled relabeling; ±40px is an exploration box, not a physical limit.
s0.units: world arclength times scale; nominal px

scale.physical_domain: Positive pixel/world scale; radius fixes the unit gauge. No calibrated independent interval.

seam_fraction.physical_domain: Periodic index-storage/cut coordinate; open cut is physical, closed storage is a gauge.

tilt.physical_domain: Annular body axis is unoriented, so tilt is periodic 180deg; no measured crochet-compatible interval.

tilt_y.physical_domain: Existing image-height orientation law; prior ±3deg exploration control, not mechanical truth.

tilt_y2.physical_domain: Existing quadratic image-height law; prior ±3deg exploration control.

turn.physical_domain: Near6.5 with abs(N*(1/turn-1/6.5))<=1; principal closed transport uses N/winding; R297 also has a frozen compact legacy turn correction.

winding.physical_domain: Integer; near N/6.5 under the closure-twist allowance.

yaw.physical_domain: Periodic pure world-rotation gauge; fixed at0. Camera roll is distinct and active.
